ARCS kitMolecule 39theme-toggle

Theme Toggle

Let a reader switch a dark kit page to light and back, follow the system setting until they choose, and print on paper colours.

States

Anatomy

#PartType roleToken (CSS variable)
1ButtonSans, body size, text only, 44px tall target; label names the mode it switches totext-secondary, hover and focus cyan
2Light remapOverrides the kit surface, text and signal tokens on :root; kit parts stay verbatimbg surface elevated border text text-secondary muted dimmed cyan green gold red and their -bg
3System defaultprefers-color-scheme: light applies the remap unless the reader chose darkcolor-scheme
4PrintPrint always uses the light remap and hides the buttonsame remap
5MemoryPre-paint head script reads the saved choice; the tail script saves it under a per-page keynone (localStorage, wrapped in try)

Usage

Use it when

  • A dark kit page will be read by a counterpart who may prefer light, or will be printed.
  • The page inlines the kit tokens, so one remap covers every part on it.

Do not use it when

  • The page is a video frame or a fixed-render surface; a frame has one look.
  • The page already has its own light palette under page-local token names (the myally family uses --pg-*); keep that one.

Data it reads

FieldTypeRequiredNote
keystringyesThe localStorage key for the saved choice, one per page family, such as brooksTheme.

Access

  • A real <button>, hidden until the script runs, so it never shows without working.
  • aria-label says Switch to light mode or Switch to dark mode; the visible label matches.
  • Focus ring is a 2px cyan outline; the target is 44px tall.
  • The light remap keeps every kit pairing at AA contrast (checked on the Brooks one-pager by page_gate).
